trigger: G (force regenerate roadmap, refresh=true) pressed on Roadmap tab (3) — TWICE across this run
reason_g_lowercase_would_noop: runDiscoveryPhase() (roadmap.ts:110-112) and runFeaturesPhase() (roadmap.ts:229-231) both short-circuit with success:true and NO LLM call whenever their output file already exists and refresh=false. The project already had roadmap.json + roadmap_discovery.json on disk, so lowercase 'g' (refresh:false, RoadmapView.tsx keymap 'g: () => generate(false)') returns instantly with a flash 'roadmap generated' and zero streaming. 'G' (refresh:true, keymap 'G: () => generate(true)') was required to force real regeneration.

run_1_manual_poll.method: manual td.current_frame() polling (not capture-frames, to avoid re-firing G each sample)
phase_transitions_observed: idle -> RUNNING discovery 30% -> RUNNING features 50% -> idle (complete, 'Contents:' summary)
run_1_manual_poll.roadmap_json_effect: 39 features -> 48 features (9 new: R1-R9); phases P2-trust-hardening, P3-team-collaboration, P4-extensibility-scale added; old P12/P13/P14 features preserved (mergeFeatures)

run_2_capture_frames_tool.method: tuistory capture-frames -s ap-pp G --count 8 --interval 3000 (documented CLI tool)
run_2_capture_frames_tool.note: generation outlived the 24s sampling window (stalled visibly at 'features 50%'); supplementary manual polling (14 more samples over ~36s) caught it complete

run_2_supplementary_poll.roadmap_json_effect: 48 features -> 58 features (10 more new features); new phase P15 appeared

combined_verdict.proof_basis: distinct rendered frames showing phase/progress text changing (idle -> discovery X% -> features Y% -> idle+summary), AND independently, roadmap.json mtime + feature-count deltas on disk after each G press confirm two separate real LLM-driven regenerations completed
